item.description: Kteos #8663 the Twice-Born of the House of Hyperenor fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Lykkles #3238 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the
item.description: Lykkles #3238 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Lykkles has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Melphon #8531 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel a
item.description: Melphon #8531 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: In the Field of Ares, Xenippo Nichphonides ~770 and Phyllphon Achestgenides ~1058 have become each other's whole world.

item.description: The fire under Kledoros Astlaides ~1495 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.
